scope: Observation API verification, not a KITTI accuracy study or solver-cause finding. All estimator parameters and stored results stay unchanged.

trace.opt_in: Fourth process argument InTenLoamPaperTrace pointer; nullptr is the default.
trace.observations: Actual S2S input/output/fallback/accepted relative, S2M prediction/input/output/acceptance, each existing iteration's H, g, update, residual sum, support counts and stop reason.
trace.residual_definition: Sum of Huber IRLS weight times squared residual before the update; not the Huber objective or an accuracy score.
trace.conditioning: Unregularized H is recorded for downstream analysis; no new condition threshold changes the solver.

native_unit_checks: Full Release build and ctest. New synthetic tests cover trace-on/off multiframe moving pose/map/prediction parity; empty-feature fallback/rejection; reset/skipped stages; zero iteration budget; convergence versus iteration limit; rejection of forced pose before state change. Existing forced-pose tests stay active.

fixture.reference_source_identity: Native tree is identical to base_commit before the trace-only changes.
fixture.selection: Default parameters and the existing KITTI 07 selected plane-check manifest, transferred unchanged to this short compatibility fixture; no fixture tuning or speed claim.
fixture.comparison: Compare all available accuracy fields, status, frame count, method and evaluated GT pose bytes against the pinned reference binary. This checks tracing-disabled compatibility; tracing-on parity is checked by multiframe synthetic tests.

limits: No original full-sequence scan is read or fetched. No KITTI failure is claimed explained. No CLI export or Python/ROS binding is added in this API change. Nonfinite-step reporting exists, but tests do not inject invalid normal equations into the private solvers.
